edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the transfer initiator address.
msg.sender becomes the recipient of the allowance update in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner passed to _approve from approve.
msg.sender is compared against uniswapV2Router/uniswapV2Pair in the Uniswap-only check.
manualswap authorization relies on require(_msgSender() == _FeeAddress).
manualsend authorization relies on require(_msgSender() == _FeeAddress).
Constructor mints the entire _rTotal to _msgSender().
cooldown[to] is written as block.timestamp + 30 seconds (timestamp dependency).
Swap deadline argument is set to block.timestamp.
addLiquidityETH deadline argument is set to block.timestamp.
Cooldown requirements compare cooldown entries against block.timestamp in _transfer.
_transfer triggers an external swap to ETH inside the transfer flow before state finalization.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract holds ETH after swapping.
swapTokensForEth performs the low-level external Uniswap swap call.
The Uniswap swap moves tokens via transfer calls that can re-enter _transfer.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to the fee and marketing wallets.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer before updating allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
transferFrom reads and updates _allowances for the spender.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer reads bots[from] and bots[to] for blacklist enforcement.
setBots writes true entries into the bots mapping via a loop.
delBot clears a bots mapping entry.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
setMaxTxPercent writes _maxTxAmount.
openTrading assigns the Uniswap router instance.
openTrading creates and stores the liquidity pair.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
_transfer finalizes by calling _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferToExcluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferFromExcluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferBothExcluded.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after a fee-free transfer.
removeAllFee caches and zeroes _taxFee.
restoreAllFee restores _taxFee from the cached value.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal, changing every reflection balance.
_reflectFee accumulates tFee into _tFeeTotal using SafeMath.add.
_takeTeam multiplies tTeam by currentRate and adds rTeam to _rOwned of the contract.
_takeTeam fetches the current rate via _getRate.
_transferStandard sub/add on _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to burn the reflected fee.
_getRate derives supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply iterates the _excluded array.
_getCurrentSupply starts tSupply from _tTotal.
_getCurrentSupply starts rSupply from _rTotal.
balanceOf converts reflections through tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection divides rAmount by the rate from _getRate.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth on the contract balance.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee on the contract ETH balance.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
ETH accepted by receive() is later forwarded to fee wallets by sendETHToFee.
Constructor sets _owner from _msgSender().
Constructor assigns _rOwned[_msgSender()] = _rTotal.
Constructor marks owner, contract and fee wallets as fee-excluded.
_transferBothExcluded updates _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_transferToExcluded credits _tOwned of the excluded recipient.
_transferFromExcluded debits _tOwned of the excluded sender.
_transfer checks the inSwap guard flag before swapping.
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping around the external swap path.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether to take fees.
_transfer reads swapEnabled to decide whether to swap contract tokens.
balanceOf reads reflection balance _rOwned for non-excluded accounts.
balanceOf reads _tOwned for excluded accounts.
_getValues obtains the current rate from _getRate.
_getValues passes _taxFee into the t-value computation.
_getValues passes _teamFee into the t-value computation.
_takeTeam conditionally adds tTeam to _tOwned of the contract.
_transferStandard diverts the team portion through _takeTeam.
